Raw PDF text extraction alone is NOT supervised model fine-tuning, and training a small language model on raw unlabelled paragraphs causes catastrophic forgetting and numeric hallucination.
ragAlternativeRecommendation: RECOMMENDED HYBRID ARCHITECTURE: (1) Use the extracted Page-Indexed RAG Dataset (rag_corpus_chunks.jsonl) as the authoritative source of factual and numerical truth at inference time. (2) Use Context-Grounded QLoRA Instruction Fine-Tuning (train.jsonl / validation.jsonl / test.jsonl) strictly to teach the local model domain terminology, table-reading syntax, mandatory [Page X] citation formatting, and strict refusal ("Insufficient evidence found in the uploaded reports.") when evidence is absent.

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: According to the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) National Statistical Compendium 2026, India's total population reached 1,441.7 million as of March 1, 2026, reflecting a decadal deceleration in annual population growth rate to 0.89% per annum (down from 1.25% in 2011).

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Total Fertility Rate (births per woman; replacement threshold 2.1)
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: The Total Fertility Rate (TFR) across India declined from 2.4 children per woman in 2011 to 1.96 children per woman in 2026, remaining below the replacement threshold of 2.1 for the fourth consecutive survey year.
Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) dropped to 23.4 per 1,000 live births, and life expectancy at birth reached 71.8 years (70.3 years for males and 73.4 years for females).

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Gross Enrolment Ratio in Higher Education
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: Among individual states, Kerala recorded the highest literacy rate and ranked as the highest-performing state in human development at 96.2% (female literacy 95.4%), followed by Tamil Nadu as the highest-performing state in Higher Education Gross Enrolment Ratio (51.8% GER) and Maharashtra as the highest-performing state in nominal GSDP contribution (₹42.6 lakh crore).

Among individual states, Kerala recorded the highest literacy rate and ranked as the highest-performing state in human development at 96.2% (female literacy 95.4%), followed by Tamil Nadu as the highest-performing state in Higher Education Gross Enrolment Ratio (51.8% GER) and Maharashtra as the highest-performing state in nominal GSDP contribution (₹42.6 lakh crore).
Consumer Price Index (CPI) headline inflation averaged 4.3% over the 12-month period, remaining within the Reserve Bank tolerance band of 4% ± 2%.
The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) 2026 recorded a Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) of 59.6% for persons aged 15 years and above.

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Labour Force Participation Rate (persons aged 15 years and above)
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) 2026 recorded a Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) of 59.6% for persons aged 15 years and above.
Female Labour Force Participation Rate (FLFPR) increased from 23.3% in 2017–18 to 41.7% in 2026, driven by rural self-employment collectives and formal digital services.
Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) expanded by 7.2% in FY 2025–26, reaching nominal GDP of USD 4,280 billion (₹357.4 lakh crore).

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Battery Energy Storage Systems (grid-scale operational storage)
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: Grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) commissioned 6.8 GWh of operational capacity in FY 2025–26, reducing peak evening thermal curtailment by 14.2%.

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Unified Payments Interface (digital public payment infrastructure)
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) processed 168.4 billion transactions in FY 2025–26 with a cumulative transaction value of ₹246.8 lakh crore (USD 2.96 trillion), representing a 28.4% year-over-year volume expansion.

Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) pipelines disbursed ₹7.82 lakh crore across 318 central and state welfare schemes in FY 2025–26, achieving cumulative audited leakage savings of ₹3.48 lakh crore through Aadhaar-authenticated beneficiary deduplication.

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: Across all 36 states and union territories, operational Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs) reached 174,820 facilities as of March 2026, delivering 2.84 billion cumulative primary care teleconsultations.
Public District Hospital bed capacity expanded to 1,480,000 beds in 2026 (up from 1,090,000 beds in 2021), while the National Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) declined to 88 per 100,000 live births.

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Ayushman Bharat Health Account (verified Digital Health IDs)
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: Verified Digital Health IDs (ABHA accounts) linked to electronic medical records reached 684.5 million citizens, and public expenditure on primary and secondary healthcare rose to 2.35% of GDP in FY 2025–26.

The 2026 National Statistical Compendium synthesizes household enumerations across 784 districts, 642,000 rural villages, and 8,450 urban frame blocks using computer-assisted personal interviewing (CAPI).

terminologyInventory.expansionOrContext: Relative Standard Error (statistical sampling precision metric)
terminologyInventory.verbatimSentence: All district-level aggregates satisfy a relative standard error (RSE) threshold below 1.25% at the 95% confidence interval.
